prefLabel.nl: Machines alleen inzetten in droge perioden
prefLabel.en: only use machinery on dry periods

definition.nl: Het uitvoeren van veldwerk met zware machines alleen wanneer de bodem voldoende droog of draagkrachtig is om structuurschade en verdichting te beperken.
definition.en: Scheduling field operations with heavy equipment only when the soil is sufficiently dry or load-bearing to limit structural damage and compaction.

en: Bilingual definition drafted for the PoC; requires validation by ReGeNL domain experts. Previous source definitions are retained in regenlmeta:originalDefinition.
